artBrief: **Romantic French cafe.** Two welcoming chairs, two cups, and an open notebook at a tiny window table; the scene celebrates conversation, not a romantic teacher relationship.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Romantic French cafe. Two welcoming chairs, two cups, and an open notebook at a tiny window table; the scene celebrates conversation, not a romantic teacher relationship. Compact French cafe vignette. Two clearly separated welcoming chairs and two cups around a tiny round table with an open notebook; window light, creamy rose and warm amber. No people.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
